mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate below 9% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as labor market tightness improves and investor confidence grows.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 9% despite labor market improving.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market optimism intensifies.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both proxies rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS >4.5%), elevated interest rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as risk aversion rises.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns in >50% of tightening periods despite FEDFUNDS >4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects robust production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market confidence in growth strengthens.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO trends upward despite supply growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 1% signals policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market uncertainty rises.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns in >60% of FEDFUNDS spikes above 1% despite high rates.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) creates a favorable demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investor sentiment improves.
regime_hint: labor market strengthening and demand growth
failure_condition: Negative returns despite both proxies moving in favorable directions (GDPC1 up, UNRATE down) in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market expansion (PAYEMS >130,000), increased employment signals sustained growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market optimism surges.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000 in a late-cycle environment.
